title: Derivation and Differentiation of Lung Progenitors from Human Fetal Lungs
author: Lim, Rawlins

steps.title: Dissect distal lung tissue
steps.instruction: Cut edge regions of fetal lung using fine forceps (11295‑10, Fine Science Tools) and scissors (14060‑09, Fine Science Tools); excise a piece ~0.5 cm × 1–3 cm away from distal edges; transfer to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and chop into 1–2 mm fragments.

steps.title: Add dissociation buffer and transfer
steps.instruction: Slightly cut the end tip of a 1 mL sterile tip, add 0.5 mL tissue dissociation buffer to the tube and mix gently; transfer the fragmented tissue with buffer into a 15 mL conical tube containing 4.5 mL tissue dissociation buffer.

steps.title: Incubate and triturate tissue
steps.instruction: Incubate on a rocker at 37 °C for 40 min with gentle swirling; every 20 min triturate 2–30 times using 1 mL sterile tips. If dissociation is incomplete, increase pipetting steps and incubation time.

steps.title: Wash dissociated cells
steps.instruction: Inspect under a bright‑field microscope for mostly single cells; add 10 mL cold tissue washing buffer and mix; centrifuge 500 g for 5 min at 4 °C (swinging bucket rotor); discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 10 mL cold wash buffer; repeat centrifugation.

steps.title: Lyse red blood cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 3 mL red blood cell lysis buffer; incubate at room temperature for 5 min; add 10 mL cold tissue wash buffer.

steps.title: Filter and wash cell suspension
steps.instruction: Filter through a 100 µm cell strainer; centrifuge 500 g for 5 min at 4 °C; resuspend pellet in 10 mL tissue washing buffer; repeat the washing step.

steps.title: Resuspend cells for MACS
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in 300 µL cold MACS washing buffer.

steps.title: Block Fc receptors
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL FcR Blocking Reagent (Miltenyi Biotec, cat 130‑059‑901); incubate 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Label EPCAM+ cells
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL CD326 (EpCAM) MicroBeads (Miltenyi Biotec, cat 130‑061‑101); mix gently by pipetting up and down; incubate 30 min at 4 °C (fridge).

steps.title: Wash labeled cells
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL MACS washing buffer; centrifuge 300 g for 10 min in a swinging bucket rotor; aspirate supernatant completely and resuspend pellet in 500 µL MACS washing buffer.

steps.title: Set up LS column
steps.instruction: Place LS column into a MACS Separator; pre‑rinse the column with 3 mL MACS washing buffer.

steps.title: Magnetically separate EPCAM+ cells
steps.instruction: Apply the cell suspension onto the LS column; discard flow‑through (unlabeled non‑epithelial cells); wash the column four times with 3 mL MACS washing buffer, adding buffer as soon as the reservoir is empty.

steps.title: Elute EPCAM+ cells
steps.instruction: Remove the column, place it on a 15 mL conical tube; add 5 mL MACS washing buffer and flush to collect the EPCAM+ distal epithelial cells.

steps.title: Count and pellet cells
steps.instruction: Count the collected cells using a hemocytometer; centrifuge 500 g for 5 min at 4 °C in a swinging bucket rotor; proceed to downstream steps the same day.
